sn38.3:1.2: “Those who teach principles” or “those who teach Dhamma” (_dhammavādino_).
sn38.3:1.4: “Holy One” (_sugata_) is a frequent epithet of the Buddha, or here, for any arahant. It is a term primarily associated with Buddhism; in later Sanskrit, followers of the Buddha were called _bauddha_ or _saugata_.
